typeDesc.qr_generate: Generates a Shell ID, creates the QR code and prints the label.
typeDesc.trolley_read: Only the Trolley ID is read from the PLC; stored for use at the Trolley-Shell Matching station.
typeDesc.funnel_screwing: Shell ID + measurement data (funnel screwing torque etc.) is read from the PLC and written to the shell.
typeDesc.trolley_shell_matching: Shell ID + Slot No is read from the PLC; matched with the last trolley read at Trolley Read and written to the shell.
typeDesc.filling: Trolley ID + Row No + measurements are read from the PLC; written to all shells in that row of the trolley.
typeDesc.probing: Trolley ID + measurements are read from the PLC; written to all shells on the trolley.
